subject: Stakeholder mapping & next steps — Acme Commerce (post-discovery)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@acmecommerce.com>
Cc: Tom Jensen <tom.jensen@acmecommerce.com>, Sarah Li <sarah.li@acmecommerce.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T15:12:00Z
Subject: Stakeholder mapping & next steps — Acme Commerce (post-discovery)

Hi Aisha —

Thanks again for taking the time today — I appreciated the chance to walk through how Redwood Inference can help Acme reduce unit cost for LLM-powered search suggestions while keeping latency under 150ms for your customer-facing flows. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Recap of discovery:
  - Primary use case: product recommendation + query suggestion across web & mobile (70% of traffic).
  - Key constraints: P95 latency <150ms, data residency in us-east, SOC 2 + contractual auditability.
  - Current stack: homegrown inference on multi-cloud; procurement and infra teams are evaluating managed options.

- Decision criteria you mentioned:
  1) Cost per token / predictable unit economics
  2) Latency SLOs and regional routing
  3) Security/compliance (SOC 2 evidence + KMS support)
  4) Procurement/contracting timeline (30–60 days preferred)

Ask: to help us map the process on our side and ensure we bring the right people, could you share a simple stakeholder map/org-chart (who the economic buyer is, who owns procurement/legal, and who will sign off on security)? If you prefer, a short email introducing the relevant folks is perfect.

Proposed next steps:
- If you can share the org chart, I’ll route a tailored security brief + an initial commercial outline (ballpark pricing and an MAP) to the right folks.
- Loop in our security lead (Neha) and AE (Rishi) for a 30-min intro call to cover SOC 2 evidence, encryption/KMS support, and procurement questions.

Availability: Rishi and Neha are available next week (Nov 9–11) in the mornings (US ET). If you have a procurement window sooner, we can prioritize.

Thanks again — looking forward to mapping stakeholders so we can move to an MAP and formal procurement steps.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0198
https://redwoodinference.com

Attachment: sample mutual action plan (MAP) stub — will share tailored version once stakeholders are identified.

From: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@acmecommerce.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Jensen <tom.jensen@acmecommerce.com>, Sarah Li <sarah.li@acmecommerce.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T09:43:00Z
Subject: Re: Stakeholder mapping & next steps — Acme Commerce (post-discovery)

Hi Marissa —

Appreciate the clear recap — that matches our notes from the call. Attached is a one-page org chart (Acme_OrgChart_v2.pdf) that shows who owns procurement and security, plus the economic buyer. Quick notes:

- Economic buyer: Rajiv Menon (SVP Product) — he will want a cost/ROI summary and risk mitigations.
- Security/Compliance: Sarah Li (you already have her CC’d) — she’ll want our SOC 2 questionnaire answered and a short tech walkthrough.
- Procurement: Tom Jensen — handles templated SaaS contracts for us; typical cycle ~4–6 weeks but can be compressed for strategic vendors.

Tom — looping you and Sarah for visibility. Sarah, would you be available for a 30-min call next Thu (Nov 11) at 10:00am ET to review SOC 2 scope and data residency? If that works, I can send a calendar invite and share any internal questionnaire we typically use.

Thanks,
Aisha
Customer Success Manager | Acme Commerce
aisha.patel@acmecommerce.com

Attachment: Acme_OrgChart_v2.pdf (1 page)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@acmecommerce.com>, Tom Jensen <tom.jensen@acmecommerce.com>, Sarah Li <sarah.li@acmecommerce.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-03T09:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Stakeholder mapping & next steps — Acme Commerce (post-discovery)

Thanks Aisha — this is super helpful.

Rishi (AE) and Neha (Security/SE) — I’m looping you both in. Key asks from Acme: org chart received, procurement timeline ~4–6 weeks (can compress), security review needed (SOC 2 + KMS). Suggested owner responsibilities: 

- Rishi: commercial intro + ballpark pricing and MAP (I’ll share templates).
- Neha: 30-min technical & security walkthrough to cover SOC 2 evidence, KMS integrations, and data residency controls.

Aisha / Sarah / Tom — are you able to confirm Thu Nov 11 10:00am ET for the security walkthrough? If so, we’ll send a calendar invite and attach a short pre-call questionnaire (helps Neha scope the call). If another time works, happy to accommodate.

Deliverables before call:
- Marissa/Rishi: ballpark pricing + MAP (sent by EOD Tues Nov 9).
- Neha: pre-call deck / SOC 2 evidence pointers.
- Acme: any internal questionnaire or security checklist you want us to complete ahead of time.

Thanks everyone — excited to keep this moving.

Best,
Marissa
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0198
thread_summary: Post-discovery thread where Redwood requests an org-chart and stakeholder mapping from Acme Commerce. Acme provides an org chart and proposes a security walkthrough time. Redwood loops in AE (Rishi) and Security/SE (Neha) and commits to sending MAP and ballpark pricing prior to scheduled security call.
